#!/bin/bash aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` mkdir oldData #aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/metadata.json oldData/metadata.json #aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/dictionary.json oldData/dictionary.json #aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/managed_inputs.csv oldData/managed_inputs.csv
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/data/metadata_new_search.json oldData/metadata.json --no-progress aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/dictionary.json oldData/dictionary.json --no-progress aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.tsv oldData/managed_inputs.tsv --no-progress #mv managed_inputs.tsv oldData/managed_inputs.tsv unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
csvcut -t -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Full Name","Data Type","Study Type","Subject Type(s)","BDC Program(s)","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Version","Phase","More Info Link","Additional Information Link (URL)","Additional Information Link (Label)","Request Access Text","BDC Program(s)" oldData/managed_inputs.tsv | csvformat -z 10000000 -D 'φ' > inputs.csv IFS='φ' [ ! -f inputs.csv ] while read study_abv study_id study_name data_type study_type subject_types program_name data_ready data_processed version phase more_info_link additional_info_link additional_info request_text program_name do if [[ "${study_id,,}" == "${datasetRef,,}" ]]; then mkdir ${study_id} mkdir ${study_id}/output echo 'refφfull_nameφabbreviationφdescriptionφdata_typeφstudy_typeφsubject_typesφprogram_nameφversionφphaseφadditional_info_linkφadditional_infoφstudy_accessionφstudy_linkφrequest_access_textφprogram_name' >> ${study_id}/output/datasets.csv echo "${study_id}φ${study_name}φ${study_abv}φφ${data_type}φ${study_type}φ${subject_types}φ${program_name}φ${version}φ${phase}φ${additional_info_link}φ${additional_info}φ${study_id}.${version}.${phase}φ${more_info_link}φ${request_text}φ${program_name}" >> ${study_id}/output/datasets.csv jq 'with_entries(select(.key | contains("'${study_id}'")))' oldData/dictionary.json > ${study_id}/subset_dictionary.json jq '[.bio_data_catalyst[] | select(."study_identifier"=="'${study_id}'")]' oldData/metadata.json > ${study_id}/subset_metadata.json
java -jar jars/NewDictionaryConverter.jar --subsetDir "./${study_id}/" #do not touch the snake it breaks without the snake just trust me here csvformat -t -u0 -U3 -Q🐍 -z 10000000 -D 'φ' ./${study_id}/concepts.tsv >${study_id}/output/concepts.csv csvformat -t -z 10000000 -D 'φ' ./${study_id}/consents.tsv > ${study_id}/output/consents.csv export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` aws s3 rm s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/${study_id}/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' aws s3 cp ./${study_id}/output/ s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/${study_id}/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN fi done < inputs.csv
